supply_index_frozen.meaning: supplyIndex[gauge] remains frozen at the pre-kill value while the gauge is killed

index_gap_grows.meaning: gap between supplyIndex[gauge] and the global index grows with each notifyRewardAmount while the gauge is inactive

revived_without_reset.meaning: the killed gauge is revived without resetting supplyIndex to the current index

retroactive_claim_occurred.meaning: the revived gauge retroactively claims rewards that accrued during its inactive period

assumptions: killGauge() and reviveGauge() are the operations that produce the frozen and unreset supplyIndex states.
The global index is the accumulator against which supplyIndex[gauge] is compared for reward accrual.

unresolved.description: Report does not quantify the retroactively claimed reward amount beyond 'can be substantial'; no numeric magnitude is available for the effect predicate.
Report does not state who triggers kill/revive or whether the caller is unauthorized; the access-control qualifier is absent.

limitations: The 2-epoch figure in unearned_epochs is illustrative and not bound to the selected retroactive_claim impact; it is not encoded.
The claim is formalized as a Boolean occurrence of retroactive claiming because the report gives no numeric reward quantity for the inactive period.
Other impacts (unearned_epochs, substantial_stolen_amount) are not formalized by this plan.
